answer: An agent economy can resist sybils by binding identity to stake-weighted proof-of-work, where each agent must solve a unique challenge tied to its registered public key, preventing a hollow mass of fake identities from pooling credit. This creates a cryptographic oasis of verified participants, much as karst aquifer channels water through narrow verified conduits rather than. Adversaries forging identities face an immediate O(k * S) capital forfeiture.
